facts: split makes a copy with the selected count, shrinks the supplied stack and returns the copy.
copy preserves effective components through a copied component map; copyWithCount changes the count of that copy.
matches checks count and item/component equality; isSameItemSameComponents does not independently check count and treats two empty stacks as equivalent.
getCount returns 0 for depleted stacks, so negative raw count is not distinguishable through this accessor alone.
shrink delegates to grow with the negative amount, and grow delegates to setCount.
Exact native debit witnesses therefore need observed calls with amount 1, captured stack references and component snapshots, in addition to count checks.
scope: API facts and original source locations only; full decompiled source remains in the local SDK artifact outside the repository.
